preconditions.description: The length of the binary string s is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of zeros and ones.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i, len(s)) if s[i:j+1].count('1') > 0 and (j-i+1) % s[i:j+1].count('1') == 0)
postconditions.description: The output is the number of awesome substrings of s.
